svg.title: Leda Distro layered architecture
svg.desc: Layered SDV distribution architecture for Eclipse Leda: Poky/Yocto base OS, OpenEmbedded meta-layer build configuration, runtime platform components (containerd, Kanto, Mosquitto, OpenTelemetry, Kuksa.VAL, cloud connectivity), and vehicle application deployment layer — each building on the layer below.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Who deploys vehicle applications on top of Leda Distro?')
sendPrompt('How does Leda Distro support vehicle application deployment?')
g.text: Layer 1 — Vehicle applications and deployment workflows
Containerised vehicle apps · OTA deployment · fleet management workflows
Pre-integrated SDV middleware — runs on top of the OS/build layer

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What do containerd and Kanto Container Management do in Leda?')
sendPrompt('What does Mosquitto local messaging provide in Leda?')
sendPrompt('What does OpenTelemetry provide in Leda Distro?')
sendPrompt('What does Kuksa.VAL Vehicle Data Broker do in Leda?')
sendPrompt('What cloud connectivity does Leda Distro provide?')

g.text: kas/common-kirkstone.yaml — declares meta-layers and build recipes
Layer 4 — Poky / Yocto base operating system
Linux kernel · base rootfs · Yocto build system — foundation for all layers above

svg.text: Each layer has a specific responsibility and builds on the lower platform / build layers — strictly unidirectional
